project.name: Vendored External Libraries
project.description:
Third-party artifacts that used to be served by the external_free remote repository (https://aonsolutions.github.io/aon-application/maven/2/external_free). That repository is gone, so each child module checks in the jar and the pom it published and installs them into the local repository during the "initialize" phase.
Every vendored artifact lives here, including the "jakarta-*" javax-to-jakarta repackages that used to sit at the top of the tree; they moved into this directory unchanged, keeping their directory names and coordinates (com.code.aon.vendor:jakarta-*).
Every directory here is a module listed below; nothing in this tree is inert.
Nothing here is rebuilt from source. The binaries are byte-for-byte what the repository served: bcprov-jdk14-jakarta and izenpesigner-applet are signed jars, and gwt-dev-jakarta, gwt-user-jakarta, jta and jimi carry no manifest at all, so repackaging them would change what the application loads at runtime.
